name: navan-browser
description: Plan business travel, compare options, manage requested bookings, and review expenses through Navan in your local desktop browser.

interface.shortDescription: Plan travel and manage requested bookings
interface.longDescription: Plan business travel, compare options, manage requested bookings, and review expenses through Navan in your browser. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks. Built and maintained by OpenAI. Uses the organization's web interface and the signed-in account's existing permissions; browser availability, product edition, and role determine supported actions. No API or MCP connection is included.
defaultPrompt: Find policy-compliant flights and hotels for this business trip.
Review my upcoming trip and compare the change options before booking.
Prepare this expense report from the receipts I provide.
